title: SRI and AT&T chairman meeting on unacknowledged projects

tellings.quote: I I was once at a meeting with uh a chairman of SRRI and AT&T.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for governments to reveal what they know about UFOs, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 1990s he was once at a meeting with a chairman connected to SRI, a large American research institute, and to AT&T, the big US telephone company. He says the talk was about secret projects that officially do not exist. If true, it would mean leaders of major private companies know about hidden UFO-related work.
